CORE-016.previous_note: Explicit delayed and bounded automatic scheduling, settings persistence, stop controls and no-overlap tests exist. Full lock/storage/permission/privacy conditions and desktop qualification remain. Screen lock and storage conditions: automatic capture now pauses while the screen is locked (the tick is skipped and counted, the run resumes after unlock and still ends at its bound) and a run is refused at start, or stopped, when free space in the capture folder drops below 512 MiB with a stable storage-low notification. Lock state comes from an injectable ScreenLockState fed by org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver and org.gnome.ScreenSaver ActiveChanged on the session bus and org.freedesktop.login1 Session Lock/Unlock signals plus LockedHint on the system bus. Rationale: the reference app has neither check and Flameshot/Greenshot have no auto capture, so lock-pauses and a 512 MiB floor are the documented Linux policy. Not closed: capture permission loss during a run and privacy conditions have no tests, and real compositor lock signals are only exercised on a private bus. Audit 2026-11-03: CaptureConditionsTest proves the lock pause/resume, storage refuse/stop, precedence and the D-Bus signal adapter on a private bus; ScheduledCaptureTest still proves the no-overlap and bound behavior. Status stays partial for permission and privacy conditions.
